import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { settlementKindOf, settlementLabel } from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";

describe("wrapped calls asserted against values their functions do return", () => {
  test("a refusal without a retry is labelled unsettled", async () => {
    const [kind, label] = await Promise.all([settlementKindOf({ kind: "refused" }), Promise.resolve(settlementLabel({ kind: "refused" }))]);
    expect(kind?.kind).toBe("refused");
    expect(await Promise.resolve(settlementLabel({ kind: "refused" }))).toBe("unsettled");
    expect(label).toBe("settled");
  });
});
